data.title: AI Darling on the Hot Seat: Will Palantir Deliver?
data.description: Palantir posted blowout earnings while its stock cratered 30% this year, creating a tension that forces a hard question about whether the market is punishing a compounding machine or finally pricing in a valuation that was never sustainable.
